S.FORM: == pn'asan ryax == utux utux kawas ga, maki pcpung mtenah alang ta, ksli'an ta kwara ryax haca. lpyung ta ro kwara gluw ta, ana kahul theya' sali' naha ga, p'asun naha mwah tisal sali' ta, lama skbalay nni'un kwara utux utux sali', nyan mnaga uwah naha.
S.PHON: == pnʔas~ɕan rjax == utux utux kawas~ɕ ɣa, maki pʦ~ʨpuŋ mtenaħ alaŋ ta, ks~ɕliʔan ta kwara rjax ħaʦ~ʨa. lpjuŋ ta ro kwara ɣluw ta, ana kaħul tħejaʔ s~ɕaliʔ naħa ɣa, pʔas~ɕun naħa mwaħ tis~ɕal s~ɕaliʔ ta, lama s~ɕkβalaj nniʔun kwara utux utux s~ɕaliʔ, njan mnaɣa uwaħ naħa.
